title: Epstein's listening post at One Brattle Square

tellings.quote: He had another listening post called One Brattle Square.

plain: Jeffrey Epstein kept what the mathematician Eric Weinstein calls 'another listening post' at One Brattle Square in Cambridge, Massachusetts, a place where he could keep close to people and hear what they were working on in the 2000s. Weinstein tells Michels this from his own reading of the released Epstein files, and he names the Harvard scientist Martin Nowak in connection with it. If he is right, Epstein had placed himself right next to Harvard's scientists.
